title: Towards Style Alignment in Cross-Cultural Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a 'style alignment' score using fine-tuned language-specific style quantifiers (evaluating politeness, intimacy, and formality) to measure the correlation between original and translated text styles, specifically comparing performance across Western and non-Western language pairs to identify Anglocentric bias in LLM translations.

Comparing the probability distributions and standard deviations of style scores from LLM-translated texts against those of texts written by native speakers to demonstrate how translation models collapse stylistic variance and extremes toward a neutral mean.
